Key Provisions:
The Code of Conduct and Ethics, which has been published on the Group’s website (https://
ncbagroup.com/group-code-of-conduct-and-ethics/), expresses the values that drive our
behavior including addressing ethical issues, integrity on reporting, adherence to policies
and procedures and addressing internal and external audit matters. The Code underpins
the Group’s ethical framework, guided by the following:
• Ethical leadership is integrated into Board and executive responsibilities to align conduct
with the Group’s values: Driven, Responsive, Open, and Trusted.
• Anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and fair treatment standards are non-negotiable and
embedded in all supplier and stakeholder engagements.
• Data privacy, confidentiality, and responsible use of Group assets are prioritised as part
of the integrity framework.
• Environmental and social responsibility is incorporated through clear commitments to
sustainability, community engagement, and compliance with local and international
regulations.
• Ethical violations are subject to prompt investigation and, where necessary, disciplinary
action, including termination and regulatory reporting.
